touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Cleobury Mortimer qualifies as a local detour through CHURCH OF ST MARY and Wayside cross on High Street, 140m south west of St Mary's Church. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.
